83273888.title: File:The Growth of Chinese Maple-red Leaves in Deep Autumn Impression (2).jpg

ObjectName.value: The Growth of Chinese Maple-red Leaves in Deep Autumn Impression (2)

Categories.value: China photographs taken on 2019-10-20|Lüshunkou|Red leaves in China|Self-published work|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Wikiversity WikiProjects|Taken with Vivo Z3i

ImageDescription.value:
This photographs' series is about the extension of Red leaves and Red autumn in depth...

I like the word 'leaves', which makes the symbols both for the verb 'leave's DOEs form'- he or she makes the departure from..., and with the same spelling for 'leaf's plural form leaves' - the flying leaves in the sky... By crossing the cultures to see, when red leaves making a beautiful flying in the sky, it's a season of autumn's 'Red Departure'.

To be honest, I cannot tell the differences between the leaves of Chinese red sweet gum and the leaves of maple. Just as an impression of things, I called it the 'Maple-red'. they were like 5-angles stars and flowers blossoming and spirits-flying all over the screen, though some small broken details were left, which was also like the impressionism painting. That's another case of 'reaching the entire red' beauty to appreciate, I thought...

Artist.value: Jason M. C., Han
